methodology_note: Study units derived from Toronto Notes SOURCE STRUCTURE (toc_inventory.json / derived/scope_packets/E.json), cross-checked against research/tn2025/unresolved_headings.json (0 entries for chapter E) and body-page OCR (derived/toronto-notes-2025/clean-ocr/) for structurally ambiguous nodes. Unlike Dermatology, chapter E's TOC page (pdf 309) is single-column and produced no two-column-merge garbling; the one genuine structural artifact is E.S03.T02/E.S03.T03, where a single long heading ('Pre-Diabetes (Impaired Glucose Tolerance/Impaired Fasting Glucose)') was split across two TOC nodes by line-wrap parsing (confirmed via body OCR, pdf 315) rather than representing two distinct topics; these are merged into one study unit (SU-E-08). E.S04.T04 (Thyroid Stimulating Hormone) and E.S04.T05 (Adrenocorticotropic Hormone) are confirmed pure cross-reference stubs ('see Thyroid, E24' / 'see Adrenal Cortex, E33') with no independent content, folded into the pituitary physiology unit (SU-E-17) rather than given standalone units; their substantive content is represented under Thyroid and Adrenal Cortex. E.S12 (Female Reproductive Endocrinology) is confirmed a single-line pure cross-reference to Gynecology with no independent chapter content.

organizational_header_nodes.E: Chapter root container - represented by all study units below.
organizational_header_nodes.E.S02: 'Dyslipidemias' umbrella heading (E3); carries no independent content beyond its five T-children (Overview of Lipid Transport, Primary Dyslipidemias, Secondary Dyslipidemias, Dyslipidemia and CAD Risk, Treatment of Dyslipidemias), each represented as its own study unit.
organizational_header_nodes.E.S03: 'Disorders of Glucose Metabolism' umbrella heading (E7); carries no independent content beyond its eleven T-children, each represented as its own study unit (SU-E-07 through SU-E-16).
organizational_header_nodes.E.S04: 'Pituitary Gland' umbrella heading (E18, raw OCR 'PituitaryGland'); carries no independent content beyond its eight T-children, represented as SU-E-17 through SU-E-22.
organizational_header_nodes.E.S05: 'Thyroid' umbrella heading (E24); carries no independent content beyond its thirteen T-children, each a distinct named thyroid condition represented as its own study unit (SU-E-23 through SU-E-35).
organizational_header_nodes.E.S06: 'Adrenal Cortex' umbrella heading (E33); carries no independent content beyond its seven T-children, represented as SU-E-36 through SU-E-42.
organizational_header_nodes.E.S07: 'Adrenal Medulla' umbrella heading (E40); carries no independent content beyond its two T-children (Catecholamine Metabolism, Pheochromocytoma/Paraganglioma), represented as SU-E-43 and SU-E-44.
organizational_header_nodes.E.S08: 'Disorders of Multiple Endocrine Glands' umbrella heading (E41); carries no independent content beyond its single T-child (Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia), represented as SU-E-45.
organizational_header_nodes.E.S09: 'Calcium Homeostasis' umbrella heading (E42); carries no independent content beyond its two T-children (Hypercalcemia, Hypocalcemia), represented as SU-E-46 and SU-E-47.
organizational_header_nodes.E.S10: 'Metabolic Bone Disease' umbrella heading (E46); carries no independent content beyond its four T-children, represented as SU-E-48 through SU-E-51.
organizational_header_nodes.E.S11: 'Male Reproductive Endocrinology' umbrella heading (E51); carries no independent content beyond its five T-children, represented as SU-E-52 through SU-E-55.
organizational_header_nodes.E.S14: 'Common Medications' umbrella heading (E57); carries no independent content beyond its five T-children, each a discipline-specific medication summary table represented collectively as SU-E-58 (reference material duplicating disease-unit management content).

study_units.title: Acronyms and Basic Anatomy Review
study_units.structural_rationale: E.S01 (raw OCR 'AcromymsS', merged_duplicate_headings records 'Basic Anatomy Review') matches the real TOC heading 'Acronyms', confirmed via body OCR (clean-ocr/0310.txt, pdf 310) which opens with a two-column acronym-definition table occupying most of the page, followed directly by the 'Basic Anatomy Review' / 'Major Endocrine Organs' heading (E.S01.T01) and Figure 1, an overview diagram of the hypothalamic-pituitary-endocrine-organ axis. Both are pure background/reference content with no independent testable clinical competency, combined into one unit.

study_units.title: Overview of Lipid Transport
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Overview of Lipid Transport', confirmed unmerged (E3). Physiology background on lipoprotein classes and transport pathways underlying the dyslipidemia units that follow.

study_units.title: Primary (Genetic) Dyslipidemias
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Primary Dyslipidemias (rare)', confirmed unmerged (E3-E4). Rare monogenic lipid disorders (e.g. familial hypercholesterolemia, familial combined hyperlipidemia).

study_units.title: Secondary Dyslipidemias
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Secondary Dyslipidemias', confirmed unmerged (E4). Dyslipidemia due to underlying conditions (diabetes, hypothyroidism, nephrotic syndrome, medications).

study_units.title: Dyslipidemia and Cardiovascular Risk Assessment
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Dyslipidemia and the Risk for Coronary Artery Disease', confirmed unmerged (E4-E5). Covers cardiovascular risk stratification and lipid screening.

study_units.title: Treatment of Dyslipidemias
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Treatment of Dyslipidemias', confirmed unmerged (E5-E6). Lipid-lowering pharmacotherapy (statins, ezetimibe, PCSK9 inhibitors) and lifestyle management.

study_units.title: Overview of Glucose Regulation
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Overview of Glucose Regulation', body-confirmed (clean-ocr/0315.txt, pdf 315, Figure 4 'Blood glucose regulation'). Physiology background (insulin/glucagon axis) underlying the glucose-metabolism disorder units that follow.

study_units.title: Pre-Diabetes (Impaired Glucose Tolerance / Impaired Fasting Glucose)
study_units.structural_rationale: E.S03.T02 ('Pre-Diabetes (Impaired Glucose Tolerance/Impaired Fasting') and E.S03.T03 ('Glucose)') are not a two-column merge but a single TOC heading whose text wrapped across two lines and was parsed into two separate nodes by the extraction pass. Body confirmation (clean-ocr/0315.txt, pdf 315) shows one continuous 'Pre-Diabetes (Impaired Glucose Tolerance/Impaired Fasting Glucose)' heading with progression risk and Diabetes Canada 2018 diagnostic criteria (IFG, IGT, A1c). Combined into a single study unit representing the real, unfragmented heading.

study_units.title: Diabetes Mellitus: Classification and Diagnosis
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Diabetes Mellitus', body-confirmed (clean-ocr/0316.txt, pdf 316): etiologic classification (T1DM, T2DM, other specific causes, gestational DM), Table 6 comparison of T1DM vs. T2DM, and Diabetes Canada 2018 diagnostic criteria (FPG, A1c, OGTT, random PG). Represented as its own unit distinct from Treatment (SU-E-10) given the diagnostic-reasoning vs. management-planning distinction.

study_units.title: Treatment of Diabetes: Glycemic Targets, Lifestyle, and Pharmacotherapy
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Treatment of Diabetes', body-confirmed (clean-ocr/0317.txt-0321.txt, pdf 317-321): individualized A1c targets, lifestyle management, stepwise non-insulin antihyperglycemic therapy (Figure 7), insulin formulations (Table 7) and regimens (Table 8), and insulin titration (Table 10). The chapter's largest and highest-yield single unit.

study_units.title: Acute Complications of Diabetes (DKA, HHS)
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Acute Complications', a distinct DM-complications subsection following Treatment. Body confirmation (clean-ocr/0319.txt, pdf 319) shows the '8 I's' precipitating-DKA mnemonic and sick-day management, consistent with this section covering diabetic ketoacidosis and hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state as the chapter's can't-miss acute presentations.

study_units.title: Macrovascular Complications of Diabetes
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Macrovascular Complications' (coronary artery disease, cerebrovascular disease, peripheral arterial disease as sequelae of DM).

study_units.title: Microvascular Complications of Diabetes
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Microvascular Complications' (diabetic retinopathy, nephropathy, neuropathy screening and management).

study_units.title: Other Complications of Diabetes
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Other Complications' (e.g. diabetic foot, infection susceptibility, gastroparesis) not captured under the macro/microvascular categories.

study_units.title: Hypoglycemia
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Hypoglycemia', body-confirmed (clean-ocr/0326.txt, pdf 326): Whipple's triad-based workup (insulin, C-peptide, proinsulin), causes (insulinoma, sulfonylurea/insulin use), and treatment (glucagon, D50W).

study_units.title: Metabolic Syndrome
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Metabolic Syndrome' (central obesity, hypertension, dyslipidemia, and hyperglycemia clustering).

study_units.title: Hypothalamic-Pituitary Axis Physiology
study_units.structural_rationale: E.S04.T01 'Pituitary Hormones' is body-confirmed (clean-ocr/0327.txt, pdf 327) as the physiology overview of anterior/posterior pituitary hormone regulation (Table 14, 'Go Look For the Adenoma Please' mnemonic). E.S04.T04 'Thyroid Stimulating Hormone' and E.S04.T05 'Adrenocorticotropic Hormone' are confirmed pure cross-reference stubs with no independent content ('see Thyroid, E24' and 'see Adrenal Cortex, E33' respectively, clean-ocr/0329.txt, pdf 329) rather than two-column merges; their substantive content is represented in the Thyroid (SU-E-23 onward) and Adrenal Cortex (SU-E-36 onward) units, so they are folded here as physiology framing rather than given standalone units.

study_units.title: Growth Hormone Disorders (Deficiency and Excess/Acromegaly)
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Growth Hormone', body-confirmed (clean-ocr/0328.txt, pdf 328): GH deficiency (short stature in children, IGF-1-based diagnosis, insulin tolerance test) and GH excess (acromegaly/gigantism etiology and pathophysiology).

study_units.title: Prolactin Disorders (Hyperprolactinemia and Prolactinoma)
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Prolactin', body-confirmed (clean-ocr/0329.txt, pdf 329): investigation (macroprolactin, MRI sella) and treatment (dopamine agonists, surgery) of hyperprolactinemia/prolactinoma, including galactorrhea and hypogonadism as presenting features.

study_units.title: Hypogonadotropic Hypogonadism
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Luteinizing Hormone and Follicle Stimulating Hormone', body-confirmed (clean-ocr/0329.txt-0330.txt, pdf 329-330): hypogonadotropic hypogonadism etiology (Kallmann syndrome, pituitary tumours/apoplexy) and hormone-replacement management.

study_units.title: Antidiuretic Hormone Disorders: Diabetes Insipidus and SIADH
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Antidiuretic Hormone', body-confirmed (clean-ocr/0330.txt, pdf 330): central vs. nephrogenic diabetes insipidus (etiology, fluid-deprivation/DDAVP diagnostic criteria) and SIADH vs. cerebral salt wasting differentiation.

study_units.title: Pituitary Pathology: Adenoma and Hypopituitarism
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Pituitary Pathology', body-confirmed (clean-ocr/0331.txt, pdf 331): pituitary adenoma mass effects and hyperfunction syndromes (cross-referenced to Neurosurgery, NS18), and hypopituitarism etiology ('The Eight I's', including Sheehan's syndrome and pituitary apoplexy) with axis-specific deficiency symptoms and dynamic testing.

study_units.title: Thyroid Hormone Physiology
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Thyroid Hormones' (synthesis, transport, and action of T3/T4), physiology background for the thyroid disease units that follow.

study_units.title: Tests of Thyroid Function and Structure
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Tests of Thyroid Function and Structure' (TSH/free T4 interpretation, thyroid antibodies, ultrasound, radioactive iodine uptake).

study_units.title: Thyrotoxicosis: Overview and Differential Diagnosis
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Thyrotoxicosis', the general approach/differential to hyperthyroid states preceding the specific etiologies (Graves', subacute thyroiditis, toxic adenoma/MNG, thyroid storm) covered in the following units.

study_units.title: Graves' Disease
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Graves' Disease', the most common cause of hyperthyroidism.

study_units.title: Subacute Thyroiditis
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Subacute Thyroiditis (Thyrotoxic Phase)'.

study_units.title: Toxic Adenoma and Toxic Multinodular Goitre
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Toxic Adenoma/Toxic Multinodular Goitre'.

study_units.title: Thyrotoxic Crisis / Thyroid Storm
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Thyrotoxic Crisis/Thyroid Storm', the chapter's can't-miss thyroid emergency.

study_units.title: Hypothyroidism
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Hypothyroidism', high-frequency general-practice presentation.

study_units.title: Hashimoto's Thyroiditis
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading "Hashimoto's Thyroiditis", the most common cause of hypothyroidism in iodine-sufficient regions.

study_units.title: Myxedema Coma
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Myxedema Coma', the chapter's can't-miss severe hypothyroid emergency.

study_units.title: Non-Thyroidal Illness (Sick Euthyroid Syndrome)
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Non-Thyroidal Illness (Sick Euthyroid Syndrome)', abnormal thyroid function tests in the setting of severe systemic illness without true thyroid disease.

study_units.title: Thyroid Nodules
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Thyroid Nodules' (evaluation algorithm, fine needle aspiration).

study_units.title: Thyroid Malignancies
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Thyroid Malignancies' (papillary, follicular, medullary, anaplastic subtypes).

study_units.title: Adrenocortical Hormone Physiology
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Adrenocortical Hormones' (cortisol, aldosterone, androgen synthesis and regulation), physiology background for the adrenal cortex disease units that follow.

study_units.title: Adrenocortical Functional Workup
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Adrenocortical Functional Workup' (cosyntropin stimulation test, dexamethasone suppression testing, aldosterone-renin ratio).

study_units.title: Mineralocorticoid Excess Syndromes (Primary Aldosteronism)
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Mineralocorticoid Excess Syndromes' (primary aldosteronism/Conn's syndrome as a cause of secondary hypertension and hypokalemia).

study_units.title: Cushing's Syndrome
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading "Cushing's Syndrome" (raw OCR 'Cushing's Syndrome'), glucocorticoid excess of exogenous or endogenous (pituitary, adrenal, ectopic) etiology.

study_units.title: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia' (21-hydroxylase deficiency and other enzyme defects causing cortisol deficiency with androgen excess).

study_units.title: Hyperandrogenism
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Hyperandrogenism' (hirsutism, virilization workup distinguishing adrenal from ovarian sources).

study_units.title: Adrenocortical Insufficiency (Addison's Disease, Adrenal Crisis)
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Adrenocortical Insufficiency', primary (Addison's) vs. secondary adrenal insufficiency and the can't-miss adrenal crisis presentation.

study_units.title: Catecholamine Metabolism
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Catecholamine Metabolism', physiology background for pheochromocytoma.

study_units.title: Pheochromocytoma and Paraganglioma
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Pheochromocytoma/Paraganglioma', a classic cause of secondary/episodic hypertension.

study_units.title: Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia' (MEN1, MEN2A, MEN2B syndromes and their component tumours).

study_units.title: Hypercalcemia
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Hypercalcemia' (primary hyperparathyroidism, malignancy-associated hypercalcemia, and other causes with diagnosis and management).

study_units.title: Hypocalcemia
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Hypocalcemia' (hypoparathyroidism, vitamin D deficiency, and other causes with diagnosis and management).

study_units.title: Osteoporosis
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Osteoporosis' (DEXA-based diagnosis, fracture risk assessment, pharmacologic management), a high-frequency general-practice presentation.

study_units.title: Osteomalacia and Rickets
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Osteomalacia and Rickets' (defective bone mineralization in adults vs. children, typically due to vitamin D deficiency).

study_units.title: Renal Osteodystrophy
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Renal Osteodystrophy' (raw OCR 'Renal Osteodystro phy' - a spacing artifact, not a merge), bone disease secondary to chronic kidney disease.

study_units.title: Paget's Disease of Bone
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading "Paget's Disease of Bone" (disordered bone remodeling, elevated alkaline phosphatase).

study_units.title: Androgen Regulation and Tests of Testicular Function
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC headings 'Androgen Regulation' and 'Tests of Testicular Function', confirmed contiguous unmerged fragments (E51-E52). Combined as shared physiology/investigation background for the male reproductive endocrinology disease units that follow.

study_units.title: Male Hypogonadism and Infertility
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Hypogonadism and Infertility' (primary vs. secondary hypogonadism workup and management).

study_units.title: Erectile Dysfunction
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Erectile Dysfunction' (vascular, neurogenic, hormonal, and psychogenic causes).

study_units.title: Gynecomastia
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Gynecomastia', body-confirmed (clean-ocr/0363.txt, pdf 363, Figure 25 'Approach to investigating gynecomastia'): investigation algorithm (hCG, LH, testosterone, estradiol) and treatment (observation, antiestrogens, surgery).

study_units.title: Female Reproductive Endocrinology (cross-reference to Gynecology)
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Female Reproductive Endocrinology' is body-confirmed (clean-ocr/0363.txt, pdf 363) as a single-line pure cross-reference ('see Gynecology, GY23') with no independent content in this chapter, analogous to Dermatology's 'Wounds and Ulcers' cross-reference fragment.

study_units.title: Endocrine Paraneoplastic Syndromes
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Paraneoplastic Syndrome', body-confirmed (clean-ocr/0364.txt, pdf 364, Table 40): ectopic-hormone-secretion syndromes associated with malignancy, including endocrine (Cushing's syndrome from ectopic ACTH, SIADH, hypercalcemia, hypoglycemia) and non-endocrine (neurologic, renal, hematologic, rheumatologic) categories in one shared table.

study_units.title: Common Endocrine Medications Reference
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC headings 'Diabetes Medications', 'Dyslipidemia Medications', 'Thyroid Medications', 'Metabolic Bone Disease Medications', and 'Adrenal Medications' under the 'Common Medications' umbrella (E57-E61) are drug-class summary tables (mechanism, dosing, side effects) that duplicate management content already represented in their respective disease study units (e.g. SU-E-10 Diabetes Treatment, SU-E-06 Dyslipidemia Treatment). Combined into one reference unit rather than five, since none introduces an independently testable competency beyond what is already captured in the disease-specific units.

study_units.title: Landmark Endocrinology Trials
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'Landmark Endocrinology Trials' (E62-E67): summary table of major clinical trials (e.g. ACCORD, UKPDS, DCCT, PREDIMED, referenced throughout the Diabetes and Dyslipidemia units above). Bibliographic/reference content, not an independently testable clinical competency.

study_units.title: References
study_units.structural_rationale: TOC heading 'References' (E68), the chapter's bibliography. Pure reference material.
